author: Sarah Eve Tucker
content: What a great service from the whole team, from customer service and booking to the delivery team. The delivery team were bang on time for delivery and collection and were super friendly. The customer service team were really informative and addressed all my questions. The toys I hired was a huge hit and I will definitely be using Dancing Cubs again and hire two rollercoaster as it was a huge hit. Both the children and the adults enjoyed the didicars and it made my son's birthday party that extra bit special for him. Thank you so much guys.
